beats.caption: Now the fleet flies 2x as much. Compared with the best alternative, about 3 points more of the fleet stays ready and failures drop from 121 to 11.
A strike knocks out most of Aravalli's hangars. Readiness ends up about the same as threshold alarms, but failures drop from 39 to 6.
All roads into Himshikhar are cut, so only airlift works. Readiness holds, and failures drop from 33 to 2.
Dust storms and a heavy monsoon wear everything out faster. Readiness is 2 points lower than threshold alarms here, but failures drop from 41 to 2.
